To care for your Bird of Paradise like a pro, place it in bright, indirect sunlight for 4-6 hours a day. Use well-draining soil with a pH of 6.0-7.5, mixing in perlite or sand to improve aeration. Water when the top 2-3 inches of soil dry out, ensuring the pot has proper drainage to prevent root rot. Keep temperatures between 65-75°F (18-24°C) and maintain high humidity, misting the plant if needed. Fertilize with a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer (20-20-20) every 2-4 weeks during spring and summer, reducing to once every 6-8 weeks in winter. Repot every 1-2 years, and prune dead leaves to encourage healthy growth
